properties.entry: select a.req_id,a.from_date,a.to_date,a.req_date,a.status,a.purpose,a.nor_req,a.nob_g_req,a.nod_g_req,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,d.quota_desc,b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id,c.block_id,e.item_title from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join quota d on a.category_type = d.quota_type join m_purpose_items e on e.item_id = a.purpose where userid=?

SELECT t1.req_id, t1.gh_id,t1.roomtype, t1.lastupdated, t1.from_date, t1.to_date, t1.nor_req, t1.nob_g_req, t1.nob_l_req, t1.status, t1.is_veh_req, t1.mode_of_req, t1.purpose, t1.ext, t1.address, t1.userid, t1.req_date, t1.nod_g_req, t1.nod_l_req, t1.roomtype, t1.family, t1.mobile_no, t1.email_id, t1.existing_req_id, t1.is_veh_req1, t1.block_id, t1.file_path, t1.category_type, t1.desg,t1.catg_file_path,t1.during_stay_conveancy,t1.catgtype, t2.veh_id, t2.mode_of_travel, t2.arrival_time, t2.arrival_place, t2.ftno, t2.arrival_date, t3.veh_id as dv_id, t3.mode_of_travel as d_mode_travel, t3.arrival_time as depr_time, t3.arrival_place as depr_place, t3.ftno as d_fno, t3.arrival_date as depr_date, t4.quota_desc, t5.desg_category, t6.item_title, t7.gh_name, t8.block_name FROM public.gad_request as t1 LEFT JOIN public.vehicle_req as t2 ON t1.req_id = t2.req_id LEFT JOIN public.vehicle_req1 as t3 ON t1.req_id = t3.req_id LEFT JOIN public.quota as t4 ON t1.category_type = t4.quota_type LEFT JOIN public.visitor_category as t5 ON t1.desg = t5.vc_id LEFT JOIN public.m_purpose_items as t6 ON t1.purpose = t6.item_id INNER JOIN public.gh_details as t7 ON t1.gh_id = t7.gh_id INNER JOIN public.room_block as t8 ON t1.block_id = t8.block_id WHERE t1.req_id=? and userid=?

select DISTINCT on (guest_details.req_id) guest_details.*,tr_allotment.room_no,tr_allotment.room_rent,gad_request.from_date,gad_request.to_date,gad_request.purpose ,gad_request.is_veh_req,gad_request.is_veh_req1,gad_request.ext,gad_request.family,gad_request.gh_id,gad_request.block_id,gad_request.address as main_address from guest_details join gad_request on gad_request.req_id = guest_details.req_id join tr_allotment on tr_allotment.req_id=gad_request.req_id where guest_details.req_id in (select a.req_id from reservation_waitinglist a where a.par_process_id=? and status!='CAN')or guest_details.req_id in(select b.req_id from reservation_main_table b where b.process_id=? and status!='CAN') order by guest_details.req_id,guest_details.guest_id

select * from ( select row_number() over (partition by req_date::date,a.req_id order by b.guest_id),a.req_id, a.from_date, a.to_date,a.purpose, a.category_type,a.mobile_no,a.email_id,b.name FROM gad_request a JOIN guest_details b ON a.req_id = b.req_id where status!='CAN' ORDER BY req_date DESC ) f1 where f1.row_number = 1;

select * from ( select row_number() over (partition by req_date::date,a.req_id order by b.guest_id),a.req_id, a.from_date, a.to_date,a.purpose, a.category_type,a.mobile_no,a.email_id,b.name FROM gad_request a JOIN guest_details b ON a.req_id = b.req_id where status!='CAN' and a.gh_id=? and block_id=? ORDER BY req_date DESC ) f1 where f1.row_number = 1;

select* from (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.req_id order by b.guest_id) AS i,a.*,b.* from gad_request a join guest_details b on a.req_id=b.req_id where a.req_id NOT IN(SELECT req_id from feedback_system) and a.req_id=? and a.mobile_no=? )f1 where f1.i=1

select a.*,to_char(a.submitted_on,'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mm')submittedd_on,to_char(a.replied_on,'dd-mm-yyyy hh24:mm')repliedd_on,c.block_name,b.gh_name from feedback_system a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id where feedback_id=? and req_id=?

select* from (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.req_id order by e.guest_id) AS i, a.req_id,a.mobile_no,to_char(a.from_date,'dd-mm-yyyy')from_date, to_char(a.to_date,'dd-mm-yyyy')to_date,to_char(a.req_date,'dd-mm-yyyy')req_date,a.status as booking_status,a.purpose,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,b.*, c.block_name,d.gh_name,f.quota_desc,e.*,g.status as finalstatus from gad_request a left outer join feedback_system b on a.req_id=b.req_id join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details d on a.gh_id = d.gh_id join quota f on a.category_type = f.quota_type join guest_details e on a.req_id=e.req_id join tr_checkin g on a.req_id=g.req_id where a.userid=? )f1 where f1.i=1
